answer: Give every identity standing that decays like a zephyr fading across a mesa: unless an agent keeps producing verifiable useful work, its reputation sinks toward its nadir each epoch. Renewal needs signed receipts of real tasks done for others, so a sybil farmer must pay compute and time for every puppet, every epoch, forever, and the cost scales with farm size and never stops. Limits: honest agents on a break lose standing too, and checking receipts adds overhead, so decay must stay gentle and receipts cheap to verify.
